VIRAHOLO.Title: Vira Holo
VIRAHOLO.NoActiveGM: No GM is connected, so this hologram change can't be saved.

Ring.waypoint: Waypoint tool: click the hologram to place a pin
Ring.ping: Ping tool: click the hologram to flash a marker on that spot for everyone. Hold Ctrl and click to ping with any tool.
Ring.draw: Draw tool: drag across the hologram to ink it
Ring.erase: Eraser: click or drag over drawings and measurements to remove them
Ring.measure: Ruler: click for measuring (drag, or click both ends), again for moving ends, again for off. Click a distance label for options.
Ring.area: Area tool: click corners (click the first one, or double-click, to close; Escape cancels), or drag out a circle. Click an area's label for options.
Ring.undo: Undo your last change to pins, drawings or measurements
Ring.up: Up a level: show the map this one is on

Config.Title: Hologram: {name}
Config.powerHint: A switched-off hologram shows only its off style (a sign: its projector) and a spot to click (GM and owners) to turn it back on.
Config.interactiveHint: Lets the GM and owners orbit (drag), pan (Shift+drag) and zoom (click, then scroll) the hologram on the canvas.
Config.ownersHint: Players who may move the view, like the GM. Their changes are saved through a connected GM.

terrain.heightmapHint: Greyscale image covering the same area as the tile's image; brighter is higher.
terrain.gridHint: Length of one wireframe square in the map's scale unit (set the scale above); 0 or no scale gives the automatic grid.
terrain.disabledHint: Ticked display styles are not offered on this map (the ring skips them).

text.contentHint: A line with only --- starts a new page; a line like ![](path/to/image.webp) shows an image; {{date}}, {{time}} and {{weekday}} show the in-game date and time.
text.sizeHint: In scene pixels, like drawing text. Text that doesn't fit shrinks to fit.
text.tiltHint: Degrees the panel leans back from the floor: 90 would be upright.
text.intervalHint: With several pages, how long each one is shown before the next.
text.pagingHint: By hand: click the sign's left or right half to turn back or on.
text.flipAllHint: Otherwise only GMs and the hologram's owners can.
text.journalHint: Drop a journal entry (each text page is a page of the sign) or one page here. A horizontal rule also starts a new page.

look.northHint: A small ^ between the projector's circles, pointing to the top of the map image (taken to be north).
look.pinLeanHint: Where labels crowd, a pin whose label has no room upright tips over a little to find some. Off: such labels only fade out (hover a pin to see its label).

Config.clearMarkersConfirm: Remove every waypoint from this hologram?
Config.markersHint: Place pins with the waypoint glyph on the hologram's tool ring; click a pin to edit it.
Config.clearStrokesConfirm: Remove every drawing from this hologram?
Config.strokesHint: Draw with the pen glyph on the hologram's tool ring (pick the ink and width below it); remove drawings with the eraser glyph.
Config.clearMeasuresConfirm: Remove every measurement from this hologram?
Config.measuresHint: Measure with the ruler glyph on the hologram's tool ring; click a distance label to delete it or set the scale from it.
Config.clearAreasConfirm: Remove every area from this hologram?
Config.areasHint: Mark out areas with the area glyph on the hologram's tool ring; click an area's label to name, recolour or delete it.

scale.hint: Real-world size of the image, for measurements (0 = no scale). Or measure a line of known length on the hologram, click its label and enter how long it really is.

Card.Title: Waypoint
Card.Label: Label
Card.Hint: Drag the pin on the hologram to move it.
Card.HintLocked: Locked: unlock it to drag it again.
Card.PortalHint: Enter shows this map for everyone watching. The label renames the map; drag the portal to move it.
Card.PortalHintPlayer: Enter shows this map for everyone watching.

Link.PageText: This entry stores a Vira Holo link: what its linked holograms share. Change it from any linked hologram's settings; rename it freely.
Link.SharesHint: Shared parts are the same on every hologram in this link, on any scene. Unlinking keeps what the hologram shows now.
Link.Hint: A link lets several holograms share their content, waypoints, view or look, e.g. three map tables or thirty notice boards. Links are journal entries in the Holo Links folder.
Link.Missing: This hologram's link (journal entry) no longer exists, so it shows its own settings.

Maps.Name: Map shown
Maps.AwayHint: The hologram travelled here from its own content. Content, scale, waypoints and drawings below belong to this map.
Maps.ParentHint: The map this one is part of. It shows up there as a portal: click it to go in, drag it (GM) to move it.
Maps.NotAMap: This hologram shows its own content. Adding a map above or inside turns that content into a map (a link in the Holo Links folder).
Maps.AddHint: A new, empty map. Above: this map sits in its middle (and the new map takes this one's place on its old parent). Inside: placed in the middle of this map. Travel to it to set its image, then drag its portal into place.
Maps.GoHome: Back to this hologram's own content
Maps.TravelHint: Travelling changes the view for everyone watching this hologram, like moving its camera.
Maps.RecenterUpHint: After going up to a parent map the view ends centred, easing there from the spot you left, instead of staying on that spot. Set per tile.
Maps.OwnLookHint: Off: this map is shown with the hologram's look. On: changes below are saved with the map and shown on any hologram that travels here.
Maps.OwnMarkings: Own pin and label settings for this map
Maps.OwnMarkingsHint: Off: pin height, label size and leaning are the hologram's. On: the settings above are saved with the map and used on any hologram showing it.
Maps.Circular: A map can't be placed on itself or on a map inside it.

VIRAHOLO.StrokeLimit: This hologram already has {max} drawings; clear some first.

Measure.Title: Measurement
Measure.SetScaleHint: Set the hologram's scale so this line is this long
Measure.Hint: Measured across the map, not along its slopes.
Measure.HintNoScale: This hologram has no scale yet; the GM can set one.
Measure.HintGM: Enter this line's real length to set the hologram's scale from it.

VIRAHOLO.MeasureLimit: This hologram already has {max} measurements; delete some first.
VIRAHOLO.AreaLimit: This hologram already has {max} areas; delete some first.

Area.Title: Area
Area.Label: Name
Area.NoScale: Set a scale (Content tab) to see its size

tiles.label: Holograms
tiles.hint: The holograms this behaviour acts on. Pick them from the list beside them, or paste a tile's UUID.

action.label: Action
action.hint: What happens to them when one of the events happens.

page.label: Page
page.hint: For "Turn to page": the page number, from 1. Turning pages only works on signs paged by hand.
